verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents OTLP ingestion and auto-instrumentation for frameworks including JS/TS ones like Vercel AI SDK and Mastra, plus a phoenix-cli npx setup and OpenInference-based instrumentation, indicating both Python and JS/TS support. However, the evidence is mostly high-level marketing docs without explicit JS/TS SDK API reference or code samples analogous to the detailed Python SDK reference (docs-28/29/30/36), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of JS/TS SDK parity. Missing for 10: explicit JS/TS SDK API reference/docs comparable to the Python SDK reference, hands-on/independent confirmation of JS/TS instrumentation working end-to-end, and clarity on feature parity between the two SDKs.
